about.title: About TimeLuxe
about.subtitle: A time tracking and payment platform built for teams that bill by the hour.
about.mission: We believe time tracking should be honest, simple, and useful. Not a surveillance tool - a shared ledger that helps teams understand where the hours go and settle pay without friction. Every feature exists to make that ledger clear for everyone who touches it.
about.value1_desc: Every number on the report is traceable to a specific day and entry. No black boxes, no hidden calculations.
about.value2_desc: Filter by any date range - a single day, a week, a month, or a custom span. Reports and payments follow the range you choose.
about.value3_desc: Payouts settle the oldest entries first. Overpaying shows up immediately so nothing gets buried or forgotten.
about.value4_desc: Managers set budgets and pay from reports. Members log time and see their running totals. Both see the same numbers, from different angles.
about.value5_desc: Log a day in seconds. Open a group report in one click. We cut every step that does not move the work forward.
about.value6_desc: From two-person startups to departments of thirty, the same ledger scales: one rate per group, one report per range, one payment record per action.
about.team1_bio: Built the first version after years of watching teams lose hours to messy spreadsheets and missing payment records.
about.team2_bio: Shapes the experience from the first click to the month-end report. Obsessed with making financial tools feel calm, not clinical.
about.team3_bio: Talks to every team that adopts TimeLuxe, learns what breaks in the real world, and turns that into better defaults.
about.cta_title: Ready to try it with your team?
about.cta_sub: Create a free account, invite your team, and log your first day - no card, no setup fee, no commitment.

howto.title: How it works
howto.subtitle: Four steps from signup to a month-end report you can trust.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.desc: Sign up with your email. Set your personal hourly rate - this is what your personal time entries are worth. You can change it anytime from your profile.

steps.title: Create or join a group
steps.desc: A group is a team with a shared hourly rate and an optional budget. Managers create groups and invite members by email. Members accept the invite and show up in the member list.

steps.title: Log your hours
steps.desc: Every day you worked, log it: pick the date, enter the hours, and choose whether it belongs to a group or to you personally. The amount is calculated instantly from the group rate or your personal rate.

steps.title: Open the report and pay
steps.desc: At any point, open a group report for a date range. You see every member, how many hours they logged, how much they are owed, and how much has already been paid. Managers record payouts directly from this view - partial or full.

howto.note1: Your personal rate only affects entries you log as personal. Group entries always use the group rate set by the manager.
howto.note2: Payments are tied to a date range, not to a single day. That way a payout can cover a full week, a month, or any span the manager chooses.
howto.note3: Every payout record stays in the history. Nothing is overwritten - the report always shows what changed and when.
howto.faq1_q: Can I use TimeLuxe for more than one team?
howto.faq1_a: Yes. You can be a member of several groups at once - for example a night shift crew and a weekend project team. Each group has its own rate and its own report.
howto.faq2_q: What happens if I overpay a member?
howto.faq2_a: The report marks the member as overpaid and shows how much extra was paid. The overpayment is visible in the payout history and the report summary, so it is easy to catch and correct.
howto.faq3_q: Do I need to log every single day?
howto.faq3_a: Only the days you want in the report. If you skip a day, it simply does not appear. The summary and totals only include the entries you actually log.
howto.faq4_q: Can I change my hourly rate later?
howto.faq4_a: Yes. Your personal rate lives on your profile and you can update it at any time. New personal entries use the new rate; earlier entries keep the rate they were logged at.
howto.faq5_a: Your account is yours. Group managers see the members and reports for the groups they manage. Payments and payout history are scoped to the group. Nothing is shared publicly.
howto.cta_sub: The fastest way to understand TimeLuxe is to log one day and open the report. Everything else builds on that.
